about: The prompt of every sound effect, before the line that ends every effect prompt is added to it (audio/RECIPE.md). Each is the cue's row of kit/03-METHOD.md section 12, made concrete: the material, the size, the distance. tools/lib/sound-batch.mjs reads this file, asks each cue at its length in audio.sfx through npm run credits, a variant as its own call with the same prompt, and a loop with the loop setting. The prompt as it was sent is kept beside each take in audio/TAKES.json.

room-tone.prompt: The air of a quiet empty carpeted office room at night, a very soft steady hush of air, no hum, no clicks, no events, nothing else

step.prompt: One soft tap of a small glossy enamel coated metal tip on a glazed ceramic tile, a single light tick, very close microphone

card-flip.prompt: A stiff card turning over on a hard surface

button-press.prompt: One large glossy plastic push button the size of a palm pressed down and bottoming out with a solid low clunk, a single press, close microphone

page-turn.prompt: A heavy stone slab the size of a tabletop flipping over on a pivot, a low whoosh of displaced air, then one solid ceramic knock as it seats, close microphone, no body sounds

earlier.prompt: A heavy ceramic slab the size of a tabletop turning over, a low rush of air, then one solid knock as it seats, close microphone
earlier.why: take 1 was heard twice as a person belching

keyboard-rise.prompt: A brushed aluminium deck sliding up out of a slot on smooth rails and stopping with a soft metal stop, close microphone

key-press.prompt: One mechanical keyboard key cap pressed down and released, a single crisp plastic click, very close microphone

turret-rise.prompt: A small metal hatch flipping open, then a small servo motor lifting a part with a short whirr, close microphone

bolt-fire.prompt: One short tight energy bolt shot, a quick dry zap like a small toy laser, small, not a cannon, a single shot

bolt-hit.prompt: One hot sharp crack of a small energy bolt striking hard plastic, a single dry snap with a tiny sizzle

sizzle.prompt: A small burn hole fizzing out on plastic, a quiet short sizzle that dies away

keys-shuffle.prompt: Many plastic keyboard key caps clattering quickly as they change places on a metal tray

slab-drop.prompt: One very heavy ceramic block landing flat on a ceramic floor, a single deep hard thud, close microphone

paper-slide.prompt: One sheet of paper sliding across a hard smooth desk, a single short soft hiss

shredder.prompt: A small office paper shredder running steadily under load, its motor grinding through paper, a constant whirr

paper-strain.prompt: A sheet of paper pulled tight between two grips, creaking and straining, quiet dry fibrous creaks

strips-zip.prompt: Many thin paper strips snapping back together side by side in one quick run, a fast rising papery flutter and rustle, paper only, no metal, no zipper

earlier.prompt: Many thin paper strips zipping back together quickly, a fast rising papery zip
earlier.why: take 1 was heard twice as a metal zipper

row-open.prompt: A small drawer mechanism sliding open and stopping with a soft thunk, a single short movement

dial-wind.prompt: A rotary telephone dial pulled round by a finger against its spring, a single ratcheting pull

dial-return.prompt: A rotary telephone dial let go and running back to rest, a fast mechanical purr ending in a soft stop

lever-pull.prompt: A mechanical slot machine lever pulled down and released, a heavy metal ratchet and a spring clunk

reels-spin.prompt: Three mechanical slot machine reels spinning with a whirr and stopping one after another with three separate clunks

coins.prompt: A burst of metal coins pouring out and scattering on a hard metal tray, bright clinking

crank-turn.prompt: One turn of a small geared metal hand crank, ratcheting clicks, a single turn

crank-runaway.prompt: A small geared metal hand crank spinning faster and faster out of control, its ratchet clicks speeding up into a rattle

flatten.prompt: A short wet flat comic splat, something soft slapped flat on a hard tile, a single splat

peel-up.prompt: Something thin and rubbery peeling off a smooth glass surface and popping back to shape, a short peel then a small pop

ball-seal.prompt: A short suck of air, then a hard clear plastic shell snapping shut with one firm click

tube-run.prompt: A hard plastic ball rolling fast down a hollow plastic tube, a rattling hollow roll

lights-down.prompt: The lights of a big room dimming, a low electrical hum falling in pitch and one relay clack

power-on.prompt: A pinball machine powering up, relays clacking, a transformer hum rising, then a short start up chime struck on mechanical bells

plunger.prompt: A pinball spring plunger pulled back and released, the spring twanging and the rod knocking into a hard plastic ball

bumper.prompt: One pinball pop bumper firing, a sharp solenoid thwack with a single bell ding, one hit

scoop-kick.prompt: A ball dropping into a hole in a pinball table and kicked out by a solenoid, a clunk then a sharp kick

flasher.prompt: One electrical relay click and the snap of a bright flash lamp firing, a single short tick and snap

ramp-roll.prompt: A hard plastic ball rolling fast along a steel wire ramp of a pinball table, a ringing metallic roll

ball-drop.prompt: One steel ball dropping onto a wooden board, a single hard knock

flipper.prompt: One pinball flipper firing, a single sharp solenoid snap and the slap of a plastic bat

doors-slam.prompt: Two heavy glass doors slamming shut together, one deep slam with a rattle of glass in metal frames

drain.prompt: A pinball rolling down the drain and dropping into the trough with a clunk, with a falling run of mechanical bells

tier-fall.prompt: A ball dropping down a short metal chute and landing on a wooden board, a metallic rattle then a knock

lift.prompt: A ball sucked up a tube by air, a rising whoosh of air ending in a soft pop at the top

spiral.prompt: A hard plastic ball rolling round and round down a plastic spiral ramp, slowing as it goes

spinner.prompt: A pinball spinner target hit hard and spinning down, fast metallic ticking that slows

drop-target.prompt: One pinball drop target knocked down, a single flat plastic clack

sling.prompt: One pinball slingshot firing, a single short rubber snap

ball-open.prompt: A hard clear plastic shell cracking open and its two halves rattling on a hard floor

checkbox.prompt: A small crisp tick, a tiny plastic switch clicking once

button-crack.prompt: A thick ceramic plate and hard plastic cracking and breaking apart as a large button is torn out of its housing, sharp cracks then small falling fragments

earlier.prompt: Hard plastic and ceramic cracking and splintering as a large button tears loose from its housing
earlier.why: take 1 was heard as a buckle snapping shut and as velcro

unfold.prompt: Metal plates and joints unfolding and locking into place one after another with small servo motors whirring, a machine putting itself together

boss-loop.prompt: A short loop of tense, slightly silly fight music, a fast plucked string and staccato bassoon figure over a snare drum march, comic cartoon chase tension, steady tempo

dart-fire.prompt: One tiny bright pew, almost a click, a very small toy dart launcher firing once

dart-hit.prompt: One small dart striking a metal plate, a tiny bright tick with a spark

slab-fire.prompt: One heavy stone block launched hard by a machine, a deep pneumatic thump and a short rush of air

popup.prompt: A flat rigid plastic panel snapping upright on a spring hinge, a single quick flap and clack

power-down.prompt: A machine losing power, its motors winding down in pitch, ending with one last metal clank

hold-music.prompt: Bland, tinny telephone hold music heard through a small phone speaker, a simple cheerful electric piano tune, thin and narrow

letter-drop.prompt: One sheet of paper landing softly on a wooden desk, a single light papery pat

stamp.prompt: A big rubber stamp slammed down on paper on a hard wooden desk, a single heavy thump

ui-tick.prompt: A small soft tick, a single tiny soft click

key-tap.prompt: A single soft tap on a laptop key, quiet and dull

ui-send.prompt: A short soft send tone, a single gentle rising pop like a message being sent

tug-lost.prompt: One sheet of thick paper ripped out of a grip and torn in two in one fast pull, a sharp dry paper tear

arms-out.prompt: Two small spring-loaded metal arms snapping out of a housing, two quick clicks close together, a light mechanical snap

dial-fling.prompt: A rotary telephone dial hitting its metal stop hard at the end of its run back, one sharp metal knock with a short spring rattle after it

earlier.prompt: A rotary telephone dial spinning back to rest and hitting its stop hard, a fast ratchet whirr ending in one metal knock
earlier.why: the event dial-fling comes at the stop, after dial-return has sounded the run back, so a whirr before the knock would put the knock late

flipper-save.prompt: A pinball flipper snapping up and striking a steel ball hard, a solenoid clack with a solid steel knock on top

session-expired.prompt: A heavy stone slab dropped flat into a wide wooden frame, one deep low slam with weight, dull and broad, no ring

earlier.prompt: A wide heavy ceramic panel dropping into place across a frame, one broad flat slam, larger and lower than a small panel
earlier.why: both takes came out as a small sharp click or a small object set down, two whole answers each saying it does not fit, and their weight sits in the mid and high bands (low band 0.021 and 0.026 of the energy)

popup-close.prompt: A small flat ceramic panel snapping shut flush into a frame, one short dull click

carpet-roll.prompt: A heavy steel ball rolling onto thick carpet and slowing to a stop, a soft muffled low rumble, no bounce

earlier.prompt: A steel ball rolling off a hard floor onto thick carpet, the bright roll turning soft and muffled, then stopping
earlier.why: take 1 was heard as a metal thing rolling on a hard floor (1 yes, 2 no on the fit), take 2 as liquid or a coin settling (0 yes, 2 no); the hard floor is dropped so that the whole second is the ball on carpet

inbox-take.prompt: A steel ball dropping into a shallow metal tray and settling, one metal clatter and a short rattle

firehouse-take.prompt: A steel ball dropping into a deep hole in a wooden board, a hollow knock and a short roll below

metrics-card.prompt: A stiff card laid flat on a ceramic desk, a short slide and one soft flat tap

skip.prompt: One firm press of a wide plastic key bottoming out on a ceramic base, a single low click
